Our Services

Physiotherapy Services at Your Home

Physio Seba specializes in stroke rehabilitation, sports injury rehabilitation, pain management, post-surgery recovery, and elderly care physiotherapy — all delivered at home across Dhaka.

Home Physiotherapy

Complete physiotherapy assessment and treatment delivered to your doorstep anywhere in Dhaka.

Stroke Rehabilitation

Structured neuro-rehabilitation to rebuild movement, strength and independence after a stroke.

Sports Injury Rehabilitation

Targeted recovery programs for athletes and active people to return to sport safely and stronger.

Post-Surgery Rehabilitation

Guided recovery after orthopedic or general surgery to restore strength, mobility and confidence.

Back Pain Treatment

Evidence-based therapy to relieve chronic or acute back pain and prevent recurrence.

Neck Pain Treatment

Relief from neck stiffness, tension and pain caused by posture, injury or desk work.

Knee Pain Physiotherapy

Pain relief and strengthening programs for arthritis, ligament injury and post-surgical knees.

Frozen Shoulder Treatment

Restore shoulder movement and reduce stiffness with structured manual therapy and exercise.

Elderly Care Physiotherapy

Gentle, safe physiotherapy to improve balance, strength and independence for senior citizens.

Pain Management Physiotherapy

Non-invasive, drug-free techniques to manage chronic pain and improve quality of life.

Home Physiotherapy

Our core service: a complete physiotherapy assessment and treatment plan delivered at your home anywhere in Dhaka, so you recover comfortably without travel or waiting rooms.

  • Full physical assessment at your home
  • Manual therapy and therapeutic exercise
  • Personalized home exercise program
  • Family and caregiver guidance

Stroke Rehabilitation

Structured neuro-rehabilitation physiotherapy for stroke patients, focused on regaining movement, balance and daily-life independence at home.

  • Gait and balance training
  • Neuro-developmental treatment techniques
  • Bed mobility and transfer training
  • Caregiver training for daily support

Sports Injury Rehabilitation

Recovery programs for sprains, strains and ligament injuries, designed to safely return athletes and active individuals to full performance.

  • Injury-specific manual therapy
  • Strength and conditioning exercises
  • Return-to-sport progression plan
  • Injury-prevention guidance

Post-Surgery Rehabilitation

Safe, progressive physiotherapy after orthopedic or general surgery — including knee replacement, hip replacement and spine surgery — delivered at home.

  • Wound-safe early mobilization
  • Progressive strength rebuilding
  • Scar and swelling management
  • Return-to-routine activity plan

Back Pain Treatment

Evidence-based physiotherapy for acute and chronic back pain, combining manual therapy, posture correction and core strengthening.

  • Spinal mobilization techniques
  • Core and postural stabilization
  • Ergonomic and lifestyle advice
  • Long-term recurrence prevention

Neck Pain Treatment

Targeted treatment for neck stiffness and pain from poor posture, prolonged screen time, whiplash or cervical spondylosis.

  • Cervical mobilization and stretching
  • Posture retraining
  • Pain-relief therapeutic exercise
  • Workstation ergonomics advice

Knee Pain Physiotherapy

Physiotherapy for knee arthritis, ligament injuries and post-surgical knees to reduce pain and restore confident movement.

  • Quadriceps and hamstring strengthening
  • Joint mobilization techniques
  • Gait correction training
  • Pain and swelling management

Frozen Shoulder Treatment

Structured manual therapy and graded exercise to reduce stiffness and gradually restore full shoulder range of motion.

  • Capsular stretching techniques
  • Progressive range-of-motion exercises
  • Pain modulation therapy
  • Home exercise routine

Elderly Care Physiotherapy

Gentle, safety-focused physiotherapy for senior citizens to maintain strength, balance and independence at home.

  • Fall-prevention and balance training
  • Joint care and gentle mobility work
  • Mobility aid guidance
  • Bedridden patient care

Pain Management Physiotherapy

Drug-free, non-invasive techniques to manage chronic pain conditions and improve day-to-day quality of life.

  • Manual therapy and therapeutic exercise
  • Electrotherapy modalities (TENS)
  • Pain education and self-management
  • Long-term lifestyle adjustment plan

Conditions We Treat

Common Conditions We Help With

Our physiotherapists have hands-on experience managing a wide range of neurological, orthopedic and age-related conditions at home.

Stroke

Mobility, balance and independence training after a stroke.

Sciatica

Relief from nerve-related leg and lower back pain.

Frozen Shoulder

Restoring shoulder range of motion and reducing stiffness.

Cervical Spondylosis

Managing neck pain and stiffness from spinal wear.

Knee Pain

Strengthening and pain relief for arthritic or injured knees.

Back Pain

Treatment for disc issues, muscle strain and chronic back pain.

Neck Pain

Relief from posture-related and injury-related neck pain.

Parkinson's Disease

Movement, balance and flexibility exercises for daily function.

Bell's Palsy

Facial muscle exercises to support nerve recovery.

Arthritis

Joint-friendly exercise to manage pain and stiffness.

About Physio Seba

Bringing Quality Physiotherapy Home, To All of Dhaka

"Seba" means care and service in Bengali — the idea our work is built on.

Physio Seba is a home physiotherapy service provider in Dhaka, Bangladesh specializing in stroke rehabilitation, sports injury rehabilitation, pain management, post-surgery recovery, and elderly care physiotherapy. We started Physio Seba because too many patients in Dhaka were skipping essential physiotherapy simply due to traffic, mobility limits or a lack of nearby clinics.

  • Qualified, experienced physiotherapists
  • Hygienic, professional home-visit protocol
  • Personalized plans for every patient and family
  • Transparent communication on progress and pricing

Our Services

Physiotherapy Services at Your Home

Physio Seba specializes in stroke rehabilitation, sports injury rehabilitation, pain management, post-surgery recovery, and elderly care physiotherapy — all delivered at home across Dhaka.

Home Physiotherapy

Complete physiotherapy assessment and treatment delivered to your doorstep anywhere in Dhaka.

Stroke Rehabilitation

Structured neuro-rehabilitation to rebuild movement, strength and independence after a stroke.

Sports Injury Rehabilitation

Targeted recovery programs for athletes and active people to return to sport safely and stronger.

Post-Surgery Rehabilitation

Guided recovery after orthopedic or general surgery to restore strength, mobility and confidence.

Back Pain Treatment

Evidence-based therapy to relieve chronic or acute back pain and prevent recurrence.

Neck Pain Treatment

Relief from neck stiffness, tension and pain caused by posture, injury or desk work.

Knee Pain Physiotherapy

Pain relief and strengthening programs for arthritis, ligament injury and post-surgical knees.

Frozen Shoulder Treatment

Restore shoulder movement and reduce stiffness with structured manual therapy and exercise.

Elderly Care Physiotherapy

Gentle, safe physiotherapy to improve balance, strength and independence for senior citizens.

Pain Management Physiotherapy

Non-invasive, drug-free techniques to manage chronic pain and improve quality of life.

Home Physiotherapy

Our core service: a complete physiotherapy assessment and treatment plan delivered at your home anywhere in Dhaka, so you recover comfortably without travel or waiting rooms.

  • Full physical assessment at your home
  • Manual therapy and therapeutic exercise
  • Personalized home exercise program
  • Family and caregiver guidance

Stroke Rehabilitation

Structured neuro-rehabilitation physiotherapy for stroke patients, focused on regaining movement, balance and daily-life independence at home.

  • Gait and balance training
  • Neuro-developmental treatment techniques
  • Bed mobility and transfer training
  • Caregiver training for daily support

Sports Injury Rehabilitation

Recovery programs for sprains, strains and ligament injuries, designed to safely return athletes and active individuals to full performance.

  • Injury-specific manual therapy
  • Strength and conditioning exercises
  • Return-to-sport progression plan
  • Injury-prevention guidance

Post-Surgery Rehabilitation

Safe, progressive physiotherapy after orthopedic or general surgery — including knee replacement, hip replacement and spine surgery — delivered at home.

  • Wound-safe early mobilization
  • Progressive strength rebuilding
  • Scar and swelling management
  • Return-to-routine activity plan

Back Pain Treatment

Evidence-based physiotherapy for acute and chronic back pain, combining manual therapy, posture correction and core strengthening.

  • Spinal mobilization techniques
  • Core and postural stabilization
  • Ergonomic and lifestyle advice
  • Long-term recurrence prevention

Neck Pain Treatment

Targeted treatment for neck stiffness and pain from poor posture, prolonged screen time, whiplash or cervical spondylosis.

  • Cervical mobilization and stretching
  • Posture retraining
  • Pain-relief therapeutic exercise
  • Workstation ergonomics advice

Knee Pain Physiotherapy

Physiotherapy for knee arthritis, ligament injuries and post-surgical knees to reduce pain and restore confident movement.

  • Quadriceps and hamstring strengthening
  • Joint mobilization techniques
  • Gait correction training
  • Pain and swelling management

Frozen Shoulder Treatment

Structured manual therapy and graded exercise to reduce stiffness and gradually restore full shoulder range of motion.

  • Capsular stretching techniques
  • Progressive range-of-motion exercises
  • Pain modulation therapy
  • Home exercise routine

Elderly Care Physiotherapy

Gentle, safety-focused physiotherapy for senior citizens to maintain strength, balance and independence at home.

  • Fall-prevention and balance training
  • Joint care and gentle mobility work
  • Mobility aid guidance
  • Bedridden patient care

Pain Management Physiotherapy

Drug-free, non-invasive techniques to manage chronic pain conditions and improve day-to-day quality of life.

  • Manual therapy and therapeutic exercise
  • Electrotherapy modalities (TENS)
  • Pain education and self-management
  • Long-term lifestyle adjustment plan

Conditions We Treat

Common Conditions We Help With

Our physiotherapists have hands-on experience managing a wide range of neurological, orthopedic and age-related conditions at home.

Stroke

Mobility, balance and independence training after a stroke.

Sciatica

Relief from nerve-related leg and lower back pain.

Frozen Shoulder

Restoring shoulder range of motion and reducing stiffness.

Cervical Spondylosis

Managing neck pain and stiffness from spinal wear.

Knee Pain

Strengthening and pain relief for arthritic or injured knees.

Back Pain

Treatment for disc issues, muscle strain and chronic back pain.

Neck Pain

Relief from posture-related and injury-related neck pain.

Parkinson's Disease

Movement, balance and flexibility exercises for daily function.

Bell's Palsy

Facial muscle exercises to support nerve recovery.

Arthritis

Joint-friendly exercise to manage pain and stiffness.
